title: 2016 Box Received in March 2018
text:
I am super disappointed at finding out that the box I received is from November 2016. Yep. You read that right. I paid $15 for a box that has been sitting on a shelf somewhere for more than a year. Everything smells kind of funky, like sadness and crushed beauty dreams. I'm on the fence about cancelling. I don't want to keep getting years-past leftovers.

Edited to add: April 2018 box was just some small samples - no full size items. This isn't worth $15 to me - Birchbox is less money if I just want samples, and they don't use old boxes. I'm cancelling this.
label: negative
